questions.text: Your team is developing a solicitation. Which of the following are appropriate uses of AI at this stage? Select all that apply.

answers.text: Generating a first draft of the RFP based on existing templates and past solicitations
Scanning compliance guidelines to flag elements missing from the draft
Deciding which vendor should receive the contract based on the scope of work
Determining whether a vendor meets legal eligibility requirements
Identifying gaps or inconsistencies in the draft scope of work

questions.text: At which stage of the procurement lifecycle is human judgment most critical and AI least appropriate as a decision-maker?

A contract manager oversees 40 active contracts across multiple departments. Vendors have begun delivering on some contracts without the City having processed required milestone approvals, and a few discount terms have lapsed unnoticed. What is the most likely root cause of these problems, and how could AI help address it?

answers.text: The contracts were poorly written at the solicitation stage; AI could help generate better RFPs in the future
The evaluation process failed to screen out unreliable vendors; AI could improve proposal scoring
Critical contract obligations are not being consistently tracked; AI could monitor milestones and flag upcoming deadlines and renewals automatically
Vendors are not submitting required documentation; AI could generate automated reminder emails to vendors
